MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB card reader fits the practical role of my earlier adapters: connecting equipment to a computer to get a specific task done.",
    "The memory card and reader bundle gives me a concrete file-transfer use, which makes it the one recommendation I would choose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices offer voice assistance, but my adapter and cable purchases do not suggest that I need voice control, video calling, or a smart speaker.",
    "The streaming sticks and camera serve entertainment and monitoring needs that I have not expressed.",
    "My earlier headset purchase does not mean I need wireless earbuds now; I have no stated replacement need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat an interest in computer accessories as an interest in electronics generally.",
    "Several Alexa devices repeat the same assumption that I want a voice assistant, without a connection to the tasks behind my purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Wi-Fi adapter, USB expansion card, display cable, and Ethernet adapter point toward connecting existing equipment and adding useful ports.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so I need a clear practical reason to interact rather than another device loosely related to something I once bought."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The card reader matches my practical connectivity interests, but most recommendations mistake those interests for a general desire for smart devices."
}
